discoveries.title: Critical Security Fix: Trading Scripts Missing Ticker Validation
discoveries.summary: Discovered 4 trading scripts could execute trades on ANY ticker without validation, violating SPY-ONLY mandate

details.problem: Scripts execute_options_trade.py, simple_daily_trader.py, guaranteed_trader.py, and rule_one_trader.py had no ticker whitelist enforcement
details.root_cause: Each script was created independently without centralized validation
details.impact: Could have allowed trades on forbidden tickers like SOFI (which caused previous losses)
details.solution: Added mandatory validate_ticker() call at the start of each script's execution flow

lessons_learned: Always enforce security at multiple layers
Centralized validation prevents drift across scripts
Autonomous agents can catch security gaps humans miss

severity_levels.critical: Immediate action required - could cause financial loss
